purpose: Compact machine-readable manifest describing files to ingest and key statistics to compute for BKE and archetype validation.

important_files.role: primary decomposition input used by v31 experiment
feature tables used for archetype gating and modeling
backtest metrics used to evaluate predictive utility
archetype definitions and narrative gating rules
live context and phase notes; must be consulted before any change

stats_to_compute.name: seasonal_test_retest_correlation
stats_to_compute.description: Pearson correlation of per-player BKE between adjacent seasons (or multi-season windows)

stats_to_compute.name: backtest_topN_enrichment
stats_to_compute.description: Enrichment or future-impact lift for top-N players by BKE versus baseline; compute precision@N and mean_abs_rank_shift

stats_to_compute.name: rmse_vs_benchmarks
stats_to_compute.description: RMSE/MAE of BKE predictions versus realized outcomes or RAPM baselines

stats_to_compute.name: variance_explained_and_compression
stats_to_compute.description: Component-wise variance explained and compression ratio from compression/variance reports

stats_to_compute.name: archetype_prevalence
stats_to_compute.description: Per-season prevalence (%) of each archetype at defined minute/possession thresholds

parsing_instructions.notes: Prefer latest versioned bke report; when parsing lambda sweeps, report recommended lambda that maximizes predictive_rho subject to mean_abs_rank_shift_vs_base <= 3.5 (this heuristic used in v31 experiment).
parsing_instructions.production_proxy_columns: When available, read production_proxy.available_columns and production_proxy.effective_weights to reconstruct production proxy scoring for top-N checks.

recommended_next_steps: Load the most recent reports/bke_v*_*.json and compute the stats in `stats_to_compute`.
Compare computed seasonal correlations to values in reports (backtest & validation) and log differences to `loop/in_progress_context.txt`.
Compute archetype prevalence and verify rarity gates; if prevalence deviates from expectations, record thresholds and consider re-tuning in `src/data_compute`.
Keep `reference/bke_repo_context_summary_for_ai.md` and this manifest under version control and update when pipeline logic or report schemas change.
